card.line: The Valley of Hamon-gog is a burial valley in Israel, east of the Sea, where Gog and all his hordes are buried after God defeats them.

moments.title: A burial place for Gog
moments.text: God says He will give Gog a burial place in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers, east of the Sea. Gog and all his hordes will be buried there, so it will be called the Valley of Hamon-gog.

moments.title: Cleansing the land
moments.text: Men are employed to pass through the land and bury the invaders who remain. Anyone who sees a human bone sets up a pillar next to it, until the gravediggers bury it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
